what_to_detect: A backup trigger resolves targeting another creature: the effect half holds a counter_change of +1/+1 counters and a keyword_change granting that creature the keywords printed below backup.
near_miss: A backup trigger resolves targeting the creature with backup itself: it gets the counters and no keyword_change is produced.
record_fields: ability provenance of the keyword-derived Backup line (script_api_type Keyword)

what_to_detect: A Backup trigger fires for a permanent that entered the battlefield as a copy of a permanent with backup (the trigger's source entity carries a copy_source).
near_miss: A Backup trigger evaluated for a copy that did not fire; a copy of a permanent without backup generates no Backup trigger, so it is not observable as a trigger record.
record_fields: ability provenance of the keyword-derived Backup line
state entity copy_source of the trigger's source
permanent_copied event of the copy's entering resolution

what_to_detect: A backup trigger resolves and its keyword_change grants the target only keywords printed below backup on the source, none the source gained from another effect.
near_miss: The source has a keyword printed below backup, which the keyword_change grants; a gained keyword never appears in the grant.
record_fields: ability provenance of the keyword-derived Backup line
state entity keywords of the source

what_to_detect: A backup trigger resolves and grants the target the keywords fixed when the trigger went on the stack, even when the source has since lost its abilities.
near_miss: None in the rule: the granted set never changes after the trigger is put on the stack; a backup resolution whose source kept its abilities is the ordinary case.
record_fields: ability provenance of the keyword-derived Backup line
state entity keywords of the source at resolution
